setting: You both live in Leeds, in separate places across the city, and you were together for six years before splitting up last spring. You both know each other's habits well, including how each of you handles stress and money, and you adopted the cat together, so you both know her routines. The last time you were in touch, you swapped a short message about a friend's broken-down car.

private_lines.Hannah: You live alone in a one-bedroom flat in Headingley and work as a payroll officer for a large firm, mostly from home with a couple of days in the office. Your days are steady: work from nine to five, a run or a gym session after, and a quiet evening with a book or a film.

situation: My ex and I, sorting out who keeps the cat.

text: Hi. I want to sort out the cat properly before it turns into a mess. Proposal: Mabel is with me Mon to Thu and with you Fri to Sun, and we swap the midweek nights every other week so neither of us gets stuck with the awkward days. Vet and food costs split 50/50. Happy to change any of it. When can you talk?
